caption: The drawing features a single, large, round pot depicted centrally against a plain, light beige background. The pot has a wide mouth with a slightly flared rim, two rounded handles attached at the shoulder on opposite sides, and a narrow, rounded base. The surface of the pot shows mottled shades of brown, ranging from light tan to dark brown, with subtle specks and areas of reddish tint, simulating the texture and color variations of earthenware or ceramic material. There is shading present within the interior of the pot and along the exterior curves to indicate depth and form. The artist’s signature is visible in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Sugar Bowl
